known_gap_found_and_fixed.original_actual_result: case assignee was soar-live-demo@thehive.local (the API-calling service account itself), not soc-l2@thehive.local
known_gap_found_and_fixed.root_cause: TheHive auto-assigns the API caller as the case's owner/assignee on creation via promote_to_case(). The code's L2-assignment eligibility check (assign_l2_verified -> l1_policy.evaluate_l2_assignment_eligibility) treated any existing non-empty assignee as 'already_satisfied (existing_analyst)' — a deliberate safety rule meant to avoid overriding a HUMAN's existing case ownership — but did not distinguish a genuine human analyst from the automation's own service account landing there first.
known_gap_found_and_fixed.severity: functional gap, not a safety violation — no unintended write occurred beyond what the code's own logic decided (deliberately) not to do

code_fix.message: Fix L2 assignment: distinguish auto-ownership from a real human assignee
code_fix.mechanism: l1_policy.evaluate_l2_assignment_eligibility() now accepts caller_login (the authenticated API caller for THIS execution, resolved via a new agent_orchestrator._resolve_caller_login() -> api.user.get_current()). Only an EXACT match between the live case's current assignee and caller_login is treated as auto-ownership eligible for reassignment to SOAR_L2_LOGIN. Any other value — a real human, a different service account, or a failed/ambiguous /user/current lookup — still fails closed and preserves the existing assignee exactly as before the fix.
code_fix.standalone_correction_function: agent_orchestrator.correct_auto_ownership_assignment() — a new, narrowly-scoped function for fixing a case assign_l2_verified() already processed once under the old behavior. Deliberately not built on assign_l2_verified() itself (that function's normal path posts an evidence comment for any fresh assignment, which would duplicate the comment already on this case). Modifies ONLY the assignee field; has no code path capable of posting a comment, triggering a notification/responder, or touching case status.
code_fix.new_tests: 41 new tests added to test_l2_assignment.py (128 total in that file, up from 87): empty assignee, already-assigned-to-target, automatic service-account ownership (the core fix), a different service account (must still be preserved), a real human assignee, missing/failed /user/current, 6 ambiguous get_current() response shapes, replay/idempotency, and zero comment/notification/containment/closure side effects during the standalone correction.
